title: Table models never hand-write a ``schema=`` placement (the layout is managed)
intent: The physical schema layout is a **deployment** decision (``DB_SCHEMA_LAYOUT``, ADR 0070): under ``flat`` every table lives in the default schema, and under ``per-module`` the migration runtime routes each package's tables into its own PostgreSQL schema via the search_path — in both layouts the model metadata stays schema-free. A hand-written ``__table_args__ = {"schema": ...}`` pins one table to a fixed schema, silently escaping the managed layout (and breaking SQLite dev/test, which parses a schema prefix as an ATTACH database name).
